meta_description: LSJ Plastering in Manchester offers professional plastering, rendering, and drywall services. Fast, reliable, and fully insured. Call today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From small repairs to complete renders, we transform your walls with precision and care. Call for a same-day quote.
services_heading: Complete Plastering Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: Whether it's internal plasterboard, external rendering, or specialist finishes, we deliver quality results on time and within budget.

services.title: Internal Plastering
services.desc: Plasterboard installation, skimming, and finishing for smooth, perfect walls. Ideal for new builds, refurbishments, and repair work.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Durable cement and silicone renders that protect your property and improve its appearance. We handle everything from preparation to finish coat.

services.title: Artisan Finishes
services.desc: Polished plaster, venetian effects, and decorative coatings. Transform plain walls into feature surfaces that catch the light.

services.title: Patch & Repair
services.desc: Small damp patches, cracks, and damaged plaster fixed quickly without fuss. Most repairs completed in a single visit.

services.title: Ceiling Work
services.desc: Suspended ceilings, textured finishes, and complete ceiling overhauls. We work in kitchens, bathrooms, and commercial spaces.

services.title: Commercial Projects
services.desc: Large-scale plastering for offices, shops, and industrial units. We work to schedule and minimise disruption to your business.

about_pullquote: We do the job once, properly, so you don't pay twice.
about_para_1: LSJ Plastering was founded in 2012 by Lee, a trained plasterer with a passion for precision and honest work. Over 14 years, we've built a solid reputation across Wythenshawe, Manchester, and beyond by showing up on time, finishing on time, and delivering surfaces that look and last. Every job — whether it's a small repair or a full commercial render — gets the same level of care and attention.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our commitment to doing the job right first time. We don't rush, we don't cut corners, and we stand behind every finish we deliver. Our customers come back because they know they'll get honest advice, a fair price, and work they can be proud of. From landlords managing multiple properties to homeowners tackling a single room, we've earned trust by respecting your time and your budget.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About LSJ Plastering

reviews.text: Had Lee and the team in to plaster our lounge after damp treatment. They were tidy, professional, and the finish is absolutely perfect. No mess, no faffing about, just brilliant work. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Needed our entire front of the house rendering before winter. LSJ quoted quickly, started on time, and finished ahead of schedule. The render looks great and they cleaned up properly at the end. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Our landlord sent them round to repair a dodgy patch on the ceiling. They sorted it in an afternoon and blended it seamlessly. Professional lads, good banter, and they didn't overcharge. Will ask for them again next time.
reviews.author: James R.
